Cause: Northbridge Pay is rejecting every payout request with HTTP 403 `ip_not_allowlisted`. The payout-sender pod itself is healthy (Running, ready, 0 restarts, image unchanged since 2026-05-06) and was successfully submitting batches until 2026-05-19 14:00 UTC. Starting with batch 8814 at 14:30 UTC, the Northbridge API began returning:
  `403 Forbidden {"error":"ip_not_allowlisted","message":"Request origin 34.201.17.88 is not on the IP allowlist for merchant MRC-20931"}`
All subsequent batches get the same error and are being requeued, which is why ~2,200 payouts have piled up. Nothing changed on our side (no deploy, no pod restart, same egress IP 34.201.17.88 throughout) — the allowlist on the Northbridge side was changed or expired on Tuesday afternoon.

Fix (for treasury ops, since engineering has no Northbridge portal login): log in to the Northbridge Pay merchant portal for merchant MRC-20931 and add egress IP `34.201.17.88` back to the API IP allowlist. Once added, the payout-sender's existing retry loop (attempt N/72, 60 min interval) will drain the 38 queued batches automatically; no redeploy or restart is needed. If treasury ops wants the queue drained faster than the hourly retry cadence, ping us after the allowlist is updated and we can bounce the pod.
